verdict.rationale: Godot has extensive first-party documentation for editor extensibility: EditorPlugin system for building custom tools/panels/docks without reloading the editor, EditorScript with _run() for scripting one-off scene/asset manipulations from the editor, EditorInterface for programmatic control of scenes/resources, and import plugins for custom asset pipelines — all usable via GDScript or C#. This is a core, well-documented Godot capability with a live Asset Library ecosystem of tools/plugins corroborating real-world use. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically praising the plugin/EditorScript workflow (community evidence covers general engine sentiment, not this specific axis).
